svg.title: Search checks each memory’s scope
svg.desc: Search runs from acme-app/apps/api/auth. Both trees contain memory-a and memory-b at the project root, memory-c and memory-d in apps/api, memory-e in apps/web, memory-f in apps/mobile, and memory-g in web-platform-team. Memory files start gray on the left. On the right, memory-a, memory-c, and memory-g are searched and turn green; the others remain gray. Four memory.md previews show their scopes. Memory-a lists apps/api and apps/web; apps/api is green because it contains the searched path. Memory-b lists apps/web and apps/mobile, so it is skipped. Memory-c has the matching apps/api/auth scope in green. Memory-d has apps/api/billing and is skipped. The team memory is available because availableToWorkspace is enabled.

g.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
